title: Austin Airport Master Plan Consultant Search
summary:
*   City officials discussed selecting a master plan consultant for a proposed new Austin Airport.
*   The meeting involved reviewing potential firms and their selection methodology with presentations and an RFP overview.
*   Airline representatives expressed their desire to be active partners in the new airport development process.
*   The FAA affirmed the qualifications of the short-listed firms and their readiness to provide financial support for the project.
